comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (92.31%) to temporin-SHa L: 23%, F=G: 15%. Chemical modification: A10 is a D-amino acid; C-terminal amidation. Activity: active against Gram- bacteria A. baumannii DSM 30007 (MIC 12.5 uM), E.cloacae DSM 30054 (MIC >100 uM), E. coli ATCC 8739 (MIC 100 uM), H. pylori ATCC 43504 (MIC 3.12 uM), K. pneumonia DSM 26371 (MIC 100 uM), P.aeruginosa ATCC 9027 (MIC > 100 uM), Gram+ bacteria B. subtilis ATCC 6633 (MIC 3.12 uM), E. faecalis DSM 2570 (MIC 25 uM), E.faecium DSM 20477 (MIC >100 uM), and S. aureus ATCC 6538 (MIC 3.12 uM). Anticancer: Breast Cancer MCF-7, Liver Cancer HepG-2, Ovarian Cancer A2780, Pancreatic Cancer MiaPaCa-2, Prostate Cancer PC-3, Skin Cancer MNT-1, Lung Cancer A549 (IC50 12.1-37 uM). Structure: helical in SDS. In vitro toxicity: normal lung fibroblast IMR-90 (IC50 33.0 uM) and normal Lung epithelium BEAS-2B (IC50 22.6 uM). Poor cell selectivity relative to cancer cells.
title: Synthesis of Second-Generation Analogs of Temporin-SHa Peptide Having Broad-Spectrum Antibacterial and Anticancer Effects
